1x2-jun11-13.caveats: All 8 requested fixtures captured pre-match; none omitted. (1) Pinnacle was not directly accessible (oddschecker/vegasinsider returned 403), so US books were used: FanDuel (4 matches, quoted in CBS Sports/SportsLine/OddsShark articles dated 2026-06-08 to 2026-06-10), Sports Interaction (2 matches, articles dated 2026-06-10), DraftKings via RotoWire odds page (1 match). (2) All odds were converted from American to decimal (e.g., -250 -> 1.40, +350 -> 4.50); decimals rounded to 2 dp (exact: -130=1.769, -105=1.952, -275=1.364, -140=1.714, -190=1.526, -475=1.211). (3) Underlying odds snapshots date from Jun 8-10, 2026, i.e., 1-3 days before kickoff; lines may have moved slightly by kickoff. Cross-check for Mexico-South Africa: ESPN/DraftKings showed Mexico -240 / South Africa +750 (no draw listed), consistent with the FanDuel line recorded. (4) Haiti-Scotland: the Sports Interaction article contained two snapshots (table: +525/+350/-275; older text: +475/+333/-190); the table values were recorded; bet365 was reported elsewhere at Scotland -225. (5) Brazil-Morocco: article also cited an earlier snapshot (-160/+290/+425); the current table values (-190/+275/+400) were recorded. (6) Australia-Turkey kicks off late Jun 13 local (early Jun 14 UTC); recorded under its fixture date 2026-06-13. (7) Official match numbers: only the opener (Match 1, Mexico-South Africa) is certain; others set to 0. (8) captured_utc reflects the local machine clock (2026-06-10T19:51Z) at retrieval time, which appears to run slightly behind the capture-day date of 2026-06-11; in either case capture precedes the first kickoff (Jun 11, 19:00 UTC).

1x2-jun14-15.caveats: All 8 fixtures captured pre-match. (1) Book: all primary odds are bet365 prices as displayed on kickoff.co.uk match pages; Pinnacle's own page (pinnacle.com/.../netherlands-vs-japan/1620849619/) is JS-rendered and returned no odds via fetch, and oddschecker, oddsportal-style aggregators, vegasinsider, squawka and sportytrader returned HTTP 403. (2) Fractional-to-decimal conversions performed: Germany 1/33=1.03, draw 18/1=19.0, Curaçao 33/1=34.0; Saudi Arabia 13/2=7.50, draw 10/3=4.33, Uruguay 4/9=1.44; Spain 1/12=1.08. (3) Cross-checks: Ivory Coast-Ecuador consistent with Sports Interaction (+260/+180/+140 = 3.60/2.80/2.40) and FanDuel via SportsLine (+250/+180/+145); Germany-Curaçao FanDuel was -2000/+1900/+4000 (1.05/20.0/41.0), so the heavy-favorite tails vary notably between books; Netherlands-Japan: another June-10 bet365 quote was +100/+275/+240 (2.00/3.75/3.40) vs kickoff snapshot 2.00/3.60/3.60 — normal line movement, treat draw/away as approximate to ±0.2. (4) Iran-New Zealand kicks off 02:00 BST June 16 (~01:00 UTC June 16) but is officially scheduled for June 15 local (Los Angeles); recorded under 2026-06-15. (5) Official FIFA match numbers not confirmed from sources, set to 0. (6) captured_utc values are from the local system clock which read 2026-06-10T19:54Z at completion while the the capture log dates it as 2026-06-11; possible clock skew of up to a few hours, immaterial since all kickoffs are 3+ days after capture. June 15 also includes Belgium-Egypt and Iran-New Zealand beyond the two named fixtures; both captured.
